title: Busan and Hamburg gain project and municipal accounts
summary: New Port automation, Busan neighbourhood access and Hamburg mobility, freight and adaptation gain dated readings. Eligible identities reach 73 projects and 39 places; these are not completed-portfolio totals.
evidence_note: Fifteen primary-source records inspected November 22. Port and municipal boundaries remain distinct. Equipment demonstrations, openings, planning decisions, future services, pilots and station-specific observations keep their respective dates and scopes.
publication_effect: Local source integration only. Historical inputs, prior cohorts, all 34 readings and cycle identities remain intact. No comparable outcome-series admission, production acceptance, Git publication, deployment, launch or stewardship completion is created.
